description: Search Washington State Department of Labor & Industries (L&I) 'Verify a Contractor, Tradesperson or Business' registry by name, license/registration number, UBI, or workers' comp account ID.

accountId.description: L&I workers' compensation account ID, e.g. `88160900` (digits only). Formatted legacy values such as `881,609-00` are accepted and normalized.
accountId.title: Workers' comp account ID (mode=byAccountId)

city.description: Only emit results located in this Washington city (case-insensitive exact match, e.g. `Seattle`). Applied server-side alongside `mode`. Leave blank for all cities.
city.title: Filter by city

fetchDetails.description: Enrich each result with the full detail record: address, bonds, insurance, business owners, violations, associated licenses, and DOSH inspections. Adds one extra request per record, so it is capped by Max items.
fetchDetails.title: Fetch full license details

licenseCategory.description: Only emit records whose contractor/trade type matches this category. Leave unset for all categories.
licenseCategory.title: Filter by license category

licenseId.description: The contractor license, electrician/plumber certificate, or registration number (e.g. `ABCAR**824BB`, asterisks included where L&I's own record has them). Partial prefixes are supported.
licenseId.title: License / registration / certificate number (mode=byLicenseId)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted license records (1-500). Results are fetched 100 at a time.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: How to search the L&I registry.
enumTitles: Search by license / registration / certificate number
Search by UBI (Unified Business Identifier) number
Search by workers' comp account ID
mode.title: Mode

name.description: Business name or last name of an individual (e.g. `smith`, `abc construction`). Partial matches are supported, minimum 2 characters.
name.title: Name (mode=byName)

sortBy.description: Order of results: L&I's own relevance ranking, or business name.
sortBy.title: Sort by

sortOrder.description: Ascending or descending, applied to the selected Sort by field.
sortOrder.title: Sort direction

statusFilter.description: Only emit records with this top-level license status. Leave unset for all statuses.
statusFilter.title: Filter by license status

ubi.description: Washington Unified Business Identifier — exactly 9 digits (e.g. `604164913`).
ubi.title: UBI number (mode=byUbi)

violationsOnly.description: Only emit records that have a safety violation and/or contractor violation flagged (`hasSafetyViolation` or `hasContractorViolation`). Useful for compliance monitoring and vendor due diligence.
violationsOnly.title: Only show licenses with violations

zipCode.description: Only emit results in this 5-digit Washington zip code (e.g. `98121`). Applied server-side alongside `mode`. Ignored if `city` is also set. Leave blank for all zip codes.
zipCode.title: Filter by zip code

title: Washington L&I Contractor License Scraper Input
